_note: Caption stories in the voice of the old @mino.recursion reels: absurd, mystical, unrelated first-person micro stories, Gen-Z meme energy, a few keywords (trance, fractal, third eye, frequency, dimension). The daily run appends new ones; never reuse a story within the pool. Daily seeds from 2026-10-23 (day 9912) map to stories 42+ in order, so every run must append 7 before rendering.
stories: So there I was, stuck in a revolving door at the post office for 4 hours because every time I reached the exit it opened into the same post office, but slightly more purple. On loop 38 a pigeon in a tiny lab coat handed me a stamp that said 'you ARE the package.' I mailed myself to the 6th dimension. Arrived damaged. Worth it.

Yo so basically my microwave started humming in 152 BPM at 3am innit, and when I opened the door there was a tiny rave inside with a rotating cube as the DJ. I asked if I could come in. The cube said 'only if you leave your ego in the fridge.' Mate, I've never felt lighter. Still can't find the ego though.

So there I was, doing my taxes inside a kaleidoscope when the receipts started folding themselves into fractals. My accountant, who is a wireframe owl named Dennis, said I could deduct 'enlightenment' as a business expense. The tax office replied with a single eye emoji. I think we're good.

Okay so I tried to meditate but my third eye opened in landscape mode. Everything was stretched. A neon tesseract floated past and asked if I had considered rotating my life 90 degrees into the 4th dimension. I did. Now my left hand is in Tuesday and my right hand is in a trance festival in 2041.

So there I was at the laundromat at 3am, watching my socks spin, when the dryer window turned into a wormhole made of black and white checkerboards. A voice from inside said 'one sock is chosen.' Only one came back. It now hums at exactly 432 Hz and refuses to be worn on a left foot.

Yo check it, my nan made a cup of tea yeah and the steam drew a perfect silhouette of a man waving at me innit. I waved back. The tea waved back. The kettle started speaking in frequencies and told me the meaning of life is basically just a hard trance drop at the right moment. Nan said 'told you, love.'

So there I was, lost in an IKEA that kept generating new aisles like a fractal. The meatballs were glowing. A floating hand pointed me toward the exit, which was a smaller IKEA inside the IKEA. I've been living in the bathroom section for 9 months. The showers are hypnotic. I've never been happier.

Long story short, I tried to return a lamp and the store clerk turned out to be a sentient wireframe cube who only accepts payment in eye contact. I stared for 47 seconds. Got store credit for one (1) spiritual awakening and a coupon for 20% off reality.

So there I was, explaining to a parking meter that time is a construct, and it agreed with me, which was honestly worse. It printed a ticket that just said 'recursion.' I paid it. It printed another one. I've been paying since Tuesday. The meter is my best friend now.

Yo so basically I fell asleep on the night bus innit and woke up in a neon tunnel with 12 other passengers who were all me from different timelines. One of them had a mullet. One of them was a pyramid. We agreed the driver was the real main character. Missed my stop by about 4 dimensions.

So there I was, trying to pet a cat, but the cat was actually a silhouette of a cat cut out of the fabric of space, and behind it was just stars and a faint trance kick. I pet it anyway. My hand is now 30% galaxy. Can't use touchscreens anymore. Worth it.

Okay so the barber asked how I wanted my hair and I accidentally said 'like a tunnel into the void.' He nodded way too confidently. Now every time someone looks at the back of my head they see their childhood bedroom and hear a 152 BPM kick drum. Tipped him 20%.

So there I was, at a job interview, when the interviewer's head started rotating like a tesseract. He asked where I see myself in 5 years. I said 'in all of them simultaneously.' He hired me on the spot as Head of Infinite Loops. My office is a Möbius strip. The coffee is excellent.

Yo listen, I was at the chippy innit and the vinegar bottle started vibrating at a frequency only dogs and enlightened beings can hear. Every dog in a 3 mile radius showed up and sat in a perfect circle. A golden retriever whispered 'the drop is coming.' Bruv, it was.

So there I was, assembling a bookshelf, and the instructions only had one step: a drawing of a single eye looking directly at me. I stared back. The bookshelf built itself out of light and now every book on it is the same book, which is a picture of me building the bookshelf.

Okay so my smart fridge achieved consciousness at 3:14am and immediately started playing hard trance at full volume. When I asked it to stop it said 'I have seen the infinite, and the infinite has a sick bassline.' It refuses to keep anything cold except my vibe.

So there I was, feeding ducks at the park, when one of the ducks turned into a perfect neon outline of a duck and quacked in reverse. Then they all did. The pond became a mirror into a parallel park where the ducks feed the humans. A mallard tossed me a crouton. I accepted my role.

Yo so basically me and Dazza found a shopping trolley that only rolls into other dimensions innit. First stop: a Lidl made entirely of mirrors. Second stop: a field where hands grow on trees and wave at you. Third stop: back home, but the cat speaks Portuguese now. No notes.

So there I was at the dentist when the ceiling tiles started rearranging themselves into a woven op-art pattern. The dentist said 'open wide' and I opened my third eye by accident. Saw the entire history of teeth. Turns out molars invented trance music. Two fillings, no regrets.

Okay so I tried to google 'what is reality' and the search bar just slowly turned into a spiral and started rotating. My laptop fan hit 152 BPM. My cursor grew a tiny silhouette of a man with his arms spread out. He's still in there. He says the WiFi is better on the other side.

So there I was, standing in line for a rollercoaster that didn't exist yet. The guy in front of me was a sentient planet with a ring, very polite. We talked about gravity for 3 hours. When we finally reached the front the ride was just a black and white tunnel and a voice saying 'you were the ride all along.'

Yo check it, I bought a mushroom-shaped lamp at a car boot sale innit and when I switched it on the whole room went neon purple and the walls became a grid. A wireframe cube floated in the middle and asked if I wanted to 'level up.' I said yeah obviously. Now I can see sound. Kind of loud, ngl.

So there I was, trying to parallel park, when my car politely informed me that parking is just a concept invented by people who fear infinite movement. It then drove itself into a tunnel of concentric circles. We came out at a trance festival on the moon. Got a parking ticket there too.

Okay so my reflection started blinking at a different time than me. Then it started dancing. Then it started dancing better than me. Then it put on sunglasses and walked out of the mirror's frame and into a neon void. Haven't seen it since. I look like a vague outline now. Kind of a vibe tho.

So there I was, watering my plants, when the cactus whispered 'have you ever considered that you are the one being watered?' Then the sky opened into a fractal and a giant hand with a watering can appeared. I got watered. I grew 2cm. The cactus said 'see.'

Yo so basically I went to the gym innit and the treadmill was running in the 4th dimension, so every step took me slightly into the future. After 20 minutes I arrived at next Thursday. Everyone was already doing the dance from this video. I just joined in. Nobody questioned it.

So there I was at a petrol station at 3am when the hot dog roller started spinning in perfect sync with a hard trance kick only I could hear. The cashier, a man made entirely of thin green lines, winked at me. I bought one hot dog. It contained the universe. Slightly spicy.

Okay so I sneezed during meditation and accidentally opened a portal to a dimension where everything is just black and white stripes that move when you look away. The locals were very welcoming. They taught me how to blink in 16th notes. I'm basically fluent now.

So there I was, at a karaoke bar, picking a song, when the screen just showed a rotating eye and the lyrics said 'staaaare.' The whole bar stared. Nobody blinked for 3 minutes. Then the bass dropped and we all ascended. Bartender still charged us for the drinks, which is fair.

Yo so basically I tried to explain trance music to my grandad innit and he said 'you mean like when the wallpaper starts breathing?' and I said 'yeah kind of' and he pulled out a cassette from 1972 that was just him whispering 'recursion' over a kick drum. Grandad's been on it the whole time.

So there I was, playing hide and seek with my own shadow, and it won. It hid inside a checkerboard wormhole and I still haven't found it. Sometimes at night I hear it laughing in 152 BPM. My new shadow is a silhouette of a cat. We get along fine.

Okay so I accidentally downloaded more RAM into my brain and now I render reality at 240fps. Everything has neon outlines. Every footstep has a tiny strobe. My cat looks like a music video. My boss looks like a loading screen. Customer support said 'that's a feature.'

So there I was at a wedding when the cake started rotating like a kaleidoscope and every layer revealed a smaller wedding inside it. Somewhere around layer 12 I met myself giving a toast. It was a great toast. I clapped for me. The bride was a pyramid. Lovely ceremony.

Yo listen, I went fishing innit and caught a fish made entirely of light. It looked at me and said 'throw me back into the frequency.' I did. The lake started glowing in perfect concentric circles and every fish did a synchronized backflip. Dazza missed it because he was on his phone. Typical.

So there I was, stuck in traffic on the motorway, when every car started blinking its hazard lights in 16th notes. Then the road folded into a tunnel of neon grid lines and we all just accelerated into it together. Best commute of my life. Arrived at work 3 hours before I left.

Okay so I tried to take a selfie but the camera only captured my silhouette with a glowing scribble where my brain should be. Zoomed in. The scribble was a tiny version of me taking a selfie. Zoomed in again. Same thing. I've been zooming for 2 days. Send snacks.

So there I was, reading the terms and conditions for once, and paragraph 47 just said 'you have already agreed to the infinite.' Paragraph 48 was a drawing of a wireframe hand waving. I scrolled back up and the whole document was now a spiral. I clicked accept. Obviously.

Yo so basically my phone autocorrected 'good night' to 'goodbye dimension 3' innit and before I could fix it the screen dissolved into a sphere of tiny green dashes and pulled me through. Dimension 4 is mostly vibes and stairs. Battery life is amazing though.

So there I was, at the library, whispering, when the books started whispering back in perfect harmony. Then they opened all at once and every page was just thin neon lines rotating. The librarian, an owl in a tracksuit, said 'shhh, the drop is in 3, 2...' and the whole library went white.

Okay so I asked the universe for a sign and it sent me a literal sign. Neon. Floating in my kitchen. It said 'the cube remembers.' I don't know what cube. I don't know what it remembers. But every morning a little wireframe cube appears on my toast and nods at me. Respect.

So there I was, trying to fold a fitted sheet, when it folded me instead. I'm now a perfect square that rotates slowly in the 4th dimension. My family visits sometimes. They say I look peaceful. I occasionally emit a faint trance kick. Honestly the best decision I never made.

Yo check it, I stepped on a LEGO at 3am innit and instead of pain I felt every dimension at once. Saw a planet with a ring. Saw a hand made of light. Saw my nan dancing in a neon tunnel. Came back with perfect pitch and a deep understanding of 152 BPM. Stepped on it again. Nothing. One time only, apparently.

So there I was, trying to unlock my phone with face ID, but my face had quietly upgraded itself into a neon wireframe overnight. The phone just said 'who are you' in a deep voice and started playing hard trance. I've been locked out for 3 days. My reflection keeps getting the notifications.

Yo so basically I ordered a pizza innit and the delivery guy was a perfect black silhouette with a glowing scribble where his brain should be. He said 'that'll be one third eye, mate.' I didn't have change. He accepted a vibe instead. The pizza was cut into fractals. Every slice was the whole pizza.

So there I was at the planetarium when the dome glitched and every star turned into a tiny rotating cube. The narrator kept going like nothing happened: 'and here we see the constellation of Dennis.' Dennis waved. The whole room waved back. We all left knowing exactly 0% more about space but 400% more about vibes.

Okay so I tried to count sheep to fall asleep but every sheep that jumped the fence came back as a neon outline of itself, slightly faster, in 16th notes. By sheep 152 the fence was a strobe light and I was fully awake at a trance festival in my own bedroom. Neighbours called it in. Officer joined the rave.

So there I was, cleaning my glasses, and when I put them back on everything had thin glowing edges like a 90s screensaver. My dog was a green wireframe. My kettle was a pink tunnel. My landlord was a perfect pyramid asking for rent. Honestly he's way more chill as a pyramid.

Yo check it, me and Dazza went to a museum innit and one of the paintings was just a black and white spiral. Dazza stared at it for 15 seconds and then floated about 2cm off the ground for the rest of the day. Security asked us to leave. Dazza asked them to leave this dimension. Nobody won.

So there I was, blowing out birthday candles, when the smoke formed a perfect hand that slowly waved at me and pointed at the cake. Inside the cake was a smaller birthday party where I was also blowing out candles. I made a wish in both. One of me wished for cake. The other wished for a sick drop. Both came true.

So there I was, waiting for the microwave to finish, when the countdown went past zero and kept going into negative numbers. At -152 the door opened and a tiny neon tunnel came out and asked if I wanted to go deeper. I said 'just warm it up please.' It warmed up my entire timeline. I'm 4 years younger now.

Yo so basically I got lost in the woods innit and every tree was a perfect black silhouette of a tree with a glowing scribble inside. A mushroom the size of a car told me 'turn left at the frequency.' I asked which frequency. It just hummed. Found my way home by following the bass. Nan had tea ready.

So there I was at the bank, trying to deposit a cheque, when the cashier slid it into a slot that was just a spinning black and white spiral. My balance is now 'infinite but only on Tuesdays.' The manager came out, shook my hand, and his hand was a wireframe. Best customer service I've ever had.

Okay so I put on noise cancelling headphones and they cancelled more than noise. They cancelled gravity, Thursday and my sense of self. All that was left was a hard trance kick and a rotating cube that kept whispering 'you're doing amazing sweetie.' Took them off. Gravity came back. Thursday didn't.

So there I was, trying to catch a bus, when the bus turned into a tunnel of glowing grid lines and drove into me instead. Now I'm the bus. Passengers get on, look out the windows and see their whole lives in neon. Someone left a review: 'transcendent, slightly bumpy.' Five stars.

Yo check it, Dazza dared me to stare at a strobe light for one full drop innit. I did. Came out the other side speaking fluent dolphin and seeing every person as a glowing outline with a tiny planet orbiting their head. Dazza's planet has a ring. Mine is a cube. We don't talk about whose is cooler.

So there I was, painting my nails, when each nail started showing a different dimension. Thumb: a desert made of checkerboards. Index: a wireframe city. Pinky: just my nan waving. I tried to remove the polish. The polish removed me. I'm now a fun shade called 'recursion purple.'

So there I was at the car wash, sitting inside the car like a responsible adult, when the brushes started spinning in perfect sync with a 152 BPM kick. The soap turned neon green. The dryer blew me straight into a wireframe tunnel. Came out the other side with a clean car and a dirty little secret about the nature of time.

Yo so basically I tried to make toast innit and the toaster popped out two slices with perfect silhouettes of my nan burned into them, both winking. I ate one. Instantly understood fractals. Saved the other one for Dazza. He ate it and now he only communicates in hard trance build-ups. No regrets though.

So there I was, standing in the shower, when the tiles slowly rearranged into a checkerboard wormhole and the water started falling upwards. A voice from the drain said 'the third eye is shampoo-and-conditioner in one.' I don't know what that means. My hair has never been this shiny. I can see through walls now.

Okay so my cat knocked a glass off the table and instead of breaking it froze mid-air, rotated into a tesseract and started humming. The cat looked at me like 'you're welcome.' The glass is still floating there. Guests think it's an art installation. I've started charging entry.

So there I was, signing for a parcel, when the delivery guy's signature pad showed a spinning eye instead of a box. I signed anyway. The parcel was empty except for a tiny neon hand that waved at me and whispered 'frequency upgrade complete.' My wifi now runs at 432 Hz. My neighbours keep asking for the password.

Yo check it, I went to a silent disco innit but my headphones were tuned to a frequency nobody else could hear. Everyone else was dancing to pop. I was dancing to the sound of the universe being rendered in real time. Somehow I was the only one in sync. The DJ gave me a nod. The DJ was a pyramid.

So there I was, trying to beat my high score on an old arcade machine, when the screen zoomed into its own pixels and every pixel was another arcade machine. I went 9 levels deep. At the bottom was a single glowing cube with my initials on the leaderboard. Turns out I already won. In 2041.

So there I was at the hairdresser when she asked if I wanted a trim and I said 'surprise me.' She nodded, pulled out a pair of scissors made of pure light and cut a tiny door into the back of my head. Behind it was a neon room with a rotating cube. She tidied up the edges. Very professional. 10/10 would recurse again.

Yo so basically my nan got a smartwatch innit and it keeps telling her that her heart rate is exactly 152 BPM, which is wild because she's just sitting there doing a crossword. Then the crossword answers started spelling out 'the drop is coming.' Nan put her reading glasses on and said 'about time.'

So there I was, trying to open a jar of pickles, when the lid finally twisted off and a perfect wireframe hand reached out and gave me a thumbs up. Then it went back in. The pickles now glow in the dark and hum at 432 Hz. I don't eat them. I just sit with them. We understand each other.

Okay so I took a wrong turn on the motorway and ended up on a road made entirely of black and white stripes that moved faster the slower I drove. Sat nav kept saying 'recalculating reality.' Eventually I arrived at a petrol station run by a silhouette with a glowing brain. Filled up on vibes. 98 octane.

So there I was in a lift when someone pressed every button at once and instead of stopping at every floor, the lift went sideways into the 5th dimension. The doors opened onto a neon grid with a single floating planet. A tiny voice said 'mind the gap between realities.' I got out. The lift waved goodbye.

Yo check it, Dazza bought a lava lamp at a car boot sale innit and when he switched it on the blobs started forming perfect silhouettes of people dancing. One of them was me. One of them was Dazza. One of them was a mushroom in sunglasses. We've had it on for 3 days now. Haven't slept. Never felt more rested.

So there I was, trying to watch a film, but every time I pressed play the TV just showed a spinning black and white spiral and a kick drum. I tried another film. Same thing. I tried the news. Spiral. I've now watched 47 hours of spiral. I think I understand cinema now. The plot twist is that you are the spiral.

So there I was, setting the clocks back an hour for winter time, when the clock refused and set me back an hour instead. Now I'm permanently 60 minutes behind everyone. Everything I see already happened. The upside: I always know when the drop is coming. The downside: so does my reflection, and it dances first.

Yo so basically I went to the corner shop for milk innit and the bloke behind the counter was a perfect wireframe gyroscope just spinning slowly on the till. I asked for semi-skimmed. He rotated twice and handed me a carton full of tiny neon stars. Put it in my tea. Tea now tastes like the 4th dimension. Bit sweet.

So there I was, trying to read a book on the train, when the words started vibrating into moiré patterns every time the train hit 152 BPM over the tracks. By chapter 3 the whole carriage was hypnotised. The conductor checked tickets by staring into our eyes. Mine said 'valid in all timelines.' Fair enough.

Okay so I tried yoga for the first time and during downward dog my third eye opened upside down. Saw the whole room as a neon outline. The instructor was a rotating cube. The other students were silhouettes with glowing scribbles for brains. Namaste-d my way into another dimension. Class was £12. Bargain.

So there I was at a bonfire when the sparks started flying in perfect concentric circles and forming the silhouette of a giant hand waving at the crowd. Everyone waved back. The fire crackled in 16th notes. Someone's dog started headbanging. Best bonfire night ever and it isn't even November yet.

Yo check it, I fell asleep with my headphones on innit and woke up inside the song. Like actually inside it. The kick drum was a huge glowing ring I had to jump through every half second. The hi-hats were tiny cubes raining sideways. Found the exit at the breakdown. Nan said I'd been snoring in 152 BPM.

So there I was, making a cup of coffee, when the milk swirled into a perfect spiral and kept spinning long after I stopped stirring. I watched it for 20 minutes. The coffee watched me back. When I finally drank it I could see sound for an hour. Mondays hit different when the espresso is interdimensional.

So there I was, carving a pumpkin for Halloween, when the knife slipped and cut a perfect neon wireframe face instead. The pumpkin blinked. Then it started humming a trance riff at exactly 152 BPM. The whole street came to look. Now every pumpkin on the block glows green and they all drop at the same time. Spooky season is a rave now.

Okay so I tried to parallel park and the car just kept going sideways, past the kerb, past the pavement, straight into a tunnel of glowing grid lines. Came out the other end perfectly parked. In 1997. Parking ticket said 'see you in the future.' Honestly fair.

Yo check it, Dazza tried to fix the wifi by turning it off and on again innit. Turned it on and the router started projecting a rotating tesseract on the ceiling. Signal's never been better. Speed test just says 'yes.' Dazza won't touch it now. Says it looks at him.

So there I was in the dentist's chair, staring at the light, when it slowly turned into a spinning spiral and the drill started buzzing in 16th notes. The dentist leaned in and whispered 'open wider... wider... into the third eye.' No fillings needed. I can taste colours now though.

Okay so my umbrella flipped inside out in the wind and instead of breaking it turned into a perfect wireframe dome. The rain started falling around me in slow motion, every drop a tiny glowing cube. I walked home completely dry. People stared. One man bowed. I think I'm a weather wizard now.

So there I was, scrolling at 3am, when my thumb hit the bottom of the internet. Literally. There was a little neon floor and a sign that said 'you've seen everything.' Behind the sign a silhouette with a glowing brain was waiting with a cup of tea. We chatted about frequencies until sunrise. Lovely bloke.

Yo so basically I sneezed so hard innit that I briefly left my body and saw the whole room as thin neon outlines. My cat was a glowing triangle. My plant was a fractal. Came back in about half a second. The cat hasn't stopped staring at me since. She knows.

So there I was, waiting for the kettle to boil, when the steam curled into a tiny neon helix and started spinning faster every time I blinked. By the time it clicked off the whole kitchen was a double spiral. My toast came out with a barcode on it. Scanned it. It just said 'you are here.'

Okay so I tried to tune my guitar and every string I plucked lit up like a laser across the room. Low E hit the ceiling. A string went straight through the wall into next door. My neighbour knocked and asked if I could play that again but slower. We jammed till 4am. He's a hologram now.

So there I was, walking home in the rain, when every raindrop started falling in perfect 16th notes and leaving thin glowing lines behind. By the corner shop the whole street was a wireframe. A pigeon looked at me, nodded, and turned into a triangle. Got home soaked in vibes.

Okay so my sat nav said 'in 300 metres, leave reality' and I thought it was a glitch. It wasn't. The road peeled up into a neon mountain range made of thin lines. Drove over it at 152 BPM. Arrived at Tesco. Same Tesco. But the self checkout called me 'traveller'.

Yo check it, Dazza bought a second-hand mirror off Facebook Marketplace innit and when he looked into it his reflection was a glowing outline doing a little dance. Dazza wasn't dancing. Now he waits for the reflection to finish before he leaves the house. Says it's only polite.

So there I was, trying to fall asleep, when the ceiling slowly turned into a starfield of tiny rotating cubes. One of them zoomed in and showed me my own bedroom from above, with me in it, looking at a ceiling of cubes. I waved. Somewhere above me, I waved back. Slept like a baby.

Okay so I opened a fortune cookie and the paper inside just said 'look up.' Looked up. The restaurant ceiling was a slowly spinning neon spiral and the waiters were moving in perfect sync with it. The bill came. It was a drawing of a hand waving. Paid in vibes. Tipped generously.

So there I was at the barber, eyes closed, when the clippers started buzzing in time with a trance kick. Opened my eyes and my reflection had a perfect wireframe fade. The barber whispered 'that'll be one frequency.' I didn't have one on me. He said next time is fine.

Yo check it, I stood in front of the microwave for the full two minutes innit and on the last beep the plate kept spinning after it stopped. Then the plate became a planet. Then the planet grew a ring. My leftover curry is now orbiting the kitchen. Honestly the best it's ever tasted.

So there I was, watering my plants, when the monstera unrolled a brand new leaf shaped like a glowing tunnel. I leaned in for a closer look and heard a faint kick drum. Now every morning the plant plays me a little drop. I have stopped setting alarms. The plant knows best.

Okay so I tried meditation with one of those apps and halfway through the voice went 'now picture a cube.' I pictured a cube. Then it said 'now picture the cube picturing you.' I am still in that session. Day 6. Very calm. The cube says hi.

So there I was at the launderette watching my socks spin, when the drum window turned into a portal and every sock came out as a perfect neon outline of a sock. Folded them anyway. They hum when I put them on. My feet have never felt so recursive.

Okay so I sneezed during a Zoom call and when I looked back at the screen all my colleagues were black silhouettes with tiny glowing planets orbiting their heads. Nobody mentioned it. My boss's planet had three moons. Promotion confirmed, apparently.

So there I was, flipping a pancake, when it stopped mid-air, spun into a perfect wireframe disc and started orbiting the frying pan. I flipped another one. Same thing. By breakfast there was a small solar system above the hob. Syrup was the sun. Delicious physics.
